$comment: PLACEMENT: put this file at the ROOT of the project you are translating (the folder holding the source files, where the translations/ output is written) — NOT in the Translation Agency toolkit folder. This copy is a template; copy it into your target project and edit it there. All fields optional; command-line flags override these. See CLAUDE.md and specializations/README.md.
$comment_specialization: The domain profile the translator panel loads. One of: general | technical | marketing | legal | <your own specializations/<name>.md>. Default is 'general'. Override per run with /translate --domain <name>.
$comment_glossary: Optional path to a project glossary (CSV: source,lang,term,context,confidence,source,notes). Overrides the specialization on any term it defines. The research pass writes/updates this file.
$comment_context: What this project IS — its purpose, audience, register/brand voice, and any domain notes. This is what lets the translator pick the right sense of a word (e.g. 'Book' = reserve vs. the object). Put a short description inline here, OR a path to a translation-context.md file. The more specific, the better the terminology.
$comment_research: Terminology-research pass (the translate-researcher agent) that builds a per-language glossary before translating. 'first-run' (default) researches the first time a project/language is translated, then reuses the saved glossary; 'always' re-researches every run; 'off' never runs it. Force a refresh any run with the --research flag.
$comment_queries: How uncertain strings are handled. 'report' (default) never interrupts you: the translator makes a best guess and logs each uncertainty to projects/<slug>/queries-<date>.md for you to review whenever you want. 'high-stakes' also asks interactively for a few legal/medical/financial terms. 'off' makes a best guess and writes no queries file.
$comment_projectPath: Absolute path to the project/files to translate (e.g. C:/Users/you/Projects/MyApp). Empty = the current directory. Override per run with /translate --path <path> or /translate <path>.
$comment_scope: Which files are translatable, relative to projectPath. include/exclude are glob lists.
$comment_output: Where translated files are written. mode 'inplace' (default) writes each translation as a sibling next to its source, swapping the language code in the name (en.json -> de.json) or appending one (guide.md -> guide.de.md); originals untouched. mode 'tree' copies every file into <projectPath>/<dir>/<lang>/ (rewriting language codes in the path) and translates the copies, leaving originals untouched. mode 'catalog' edits existing per-language files in place (messages.<lang>.ts, de.json, .po). 'dir' is only used by tree mode.
$comment_gates: verifyCmd runs per-batch (cheap type/lint check). buildCmd runs once at the end. Leave empty for plain document sets.
$comment_wordpress: For WordPress projects. textdomain is the plugin/theme text domain; makeMo/makeJson compile artifacts from the translated .po files (needs WP-CLI or gettext tools).
